event_data.context: PR #30 squash merged as e01b008 after exact App approval of 2204318 and successful CI 45535682816. The same revision passed the full 103-test suite with live PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6. Final audit remains active. The tagged legacy readers filter by consumer kind before limiting candidates and omit incompatible decodes afterward. PostgreSQL and SQLite legacy cursors additionally order by UUID. These behaviors need explicit compatibility coverage.
